validity.researcher_notes: Answers the length_ratio flag (drawn 364 km vs sheet 877.86 km, ratio 0.41). The standalone PNGRB tariff order for this exact network -- Ref No. TO/2023-24/11, dated 27/12/2023 (https://www.pngrb.gov.in/pdf/orders/KGBNGPL_28122023.pdf) -- is titled 'Review of unit natural gas pipeline tariff... for K G Basin Natural Gas Pipeline network ("KGBNGPL") of GAIL (India) Limited ("GAIL")', Entity: 'GAIL (India) Limited ("GAIL" or "Entity")'. The PNGRB Tariff-MIS register (https://pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/20260113-NGPL-Tariff-MIS.pdf) gives authorised length 878 km / operating length 867 km as on 31.03.2025, matching the sheet's 877.86 km within the register's rounding (already cited by the register-crosswalk leg's Length [ref] fill on this PID, which draws on the physical-progress register's identical 878.0/867.0 km split). The KG Basin system is a distribution network across East Godavari, West Godavari and Krishna Districts of Andhra Pradesh, receiving gas from ONGC, Cairn (CEIL), RGTIL and other suppliers and feeding multiple fertiliser/power consumers -- a gathering-and-distribution network, not a single corridor -- so a single 364 km drawn trunk understates the true network extent by design. No value change proposed. Company-wide operator note (not separately flagged on this row, so no fill staged here): the KGBNGPL tariff order above names GAIL as Entity under the PNGRB Act §22 framework covering entities 'laying, building, operating or expanding' the pipeline -- the same operator determination made for P0904/P0923/P0943 in this brief applies to this network too.
